claims.text: Bupropion (Wellbutrin XL) contraindicated w current or prior bulimia or anorexia nervosa: higher seizure incidence
claims.quote: Wellbutrin XL is contraindicated in patients with a current or prior diagnosis of bulimia or anorexia nervosa as a higher incidence of seizures was observed in such patients treated with Wellbutrin XL

claims.text: Do not use bupropion in bulimia nervosa (↑ risk of epileptic episodes)
claims.quote: Bupropion should not be used in patients with bulimia nervosa because of the increased risk of epileptic episodes.
